scope: Allow existing GraphStorage liveness allocation for immutable multi-node CacheEncode recipes. Keep single-node and PagedRead rules; no native kernel/resource/lock/API or arithmetic change.
change: Remove encoders==0 from the multi-node use_liveness condition. Existing callback owners/reserved calls array, all graph nodes/source edges, invalid flag reset/read, published-root flags, mapped ports and worker retirement stay unchanged.
complexity: The prior one-encoder exclusion gave a chain ofN full-size arithmetic intermediates flat Θ(N·M) private payload. Native gallocr can reuse only dead internal tensors, giving a bounded live payload frontier for this trace; graph metadata remains Θ(N). No throughput claim.
toolchain: Windows x64 MSVC14.50.35717 /O2 /MD /W4 /WX; direct fresh provider/tests/native_batch/selector and existing same-pin foundation+four retained HYCA native ops objects/DLLs. Native kernels were not rebuilt; no full SDK/HEAD build or staging.

tests.ffa4: 6/6: two new CacheEncode storage tests and four existing public encoder reference/error/recovery tests.
tests.mixed: 5/5: new published-root/two-slot/bytes test and the same four existing public encoder tests. No second cold-allocation sample.
tests.new_binding_test: 64Neg→Q8 or FP8, intermediate31 published. Two invocation slots each execute with two independently retained caller Buffer sets at4-byte subview offsets. Exact source preservation, odd published intermediate, independent block-constant Q8 scale/sign bytes and FP8 .5/1/1.5 codes; earlier output buffer survives rebinding.
tests.scratch_graph: One FFA consumer process, Q8 and FP8. Actual public Graph compile/bind/submit/wait with current ggml_regions factory, one native ggml step, two slots and published odd intermediate. Accepted InvalidArgument terminates and retires failed Invocation; retry rejected, other slot output unchanged, fresh Invocation succeeds. Graph provider factory is explicit; default CPU route factory and mixed Graph variant not exercised.

cold_private_allocation.shape: F32[256,1024],64Neg→Q8, only encoded U8 result published. One slot per arm after compilation; no caller input/output payload allocation and no graph execution.
cold_private_allocation.method: StatsAllocator incremental live requested bytes across native create_invocation, includes tracked backing, graph metadata and native workspace. Same FFA module/library closure in both arms; one sample each, no latency collector.
cold_private_allocation.limits: Not RSS, peak resident, complete C/global-new allocation count or engine end-to-end footprint. Caller tensors are outside the private count; global C malloc metadata remains untracked.
